name: Zorkmachy
author: Ninepoint Labs
description: Zork I, II and III in a bar panel. The original Infocom games (MIT-licensed by Microsoft) run on the frotz Z-machine interpreter; every move is saved, so you can pick up the adventure whenever you like.

barWidget.description: Play Zork I, II and III from the bar. Auto-saves after every move.

schema.label: Show the current game and score next to the icon
